ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels occupy approximately 75% of the visible surface, with low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central vertical column and along the perimeter.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large contiguous white regions cover the majority of the lateral lobes. A dark, irregular pigmentation mass is centered at the median notch, extending outward into the inner lobes. Fine-grained dark mottling is localized at the distal tips and along the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 55 degrees and a deep vertical incision depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge. Left lobe shows moderate-frequency, low-amplitude serrations. Right lobe exhibits significant high-amplitude jagged interruptions and missing tissue segments on the inner section near the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a concave trajectory from the notch before transitioning to a convex sweep toward the distal tips, which are sharply tapered and curved upward.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dark, high-contrast circular and semi-circular pixel clusters are visible at the fluke tips and intermittently along the trailing edges, indicating focal scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous dark, non-aligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are present across both lobes. The left lobe displays a series of roughly parallel vertical-to-diagonal marks, while the right lobe contains intersecting linear scratches.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular tissue loss (deep notches) on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe; extensive rake mark scarring across the ventral surface of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy concentrations of dark speckling and stippling localized along the leading edge boundaries.
